args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

round_money's docstring promised banker's rounding but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`. `round_money` in `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so `Decimal("2.665")` rounded to `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switch `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (and update the import accordingly).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed**

Refs: FIN-212

Done. Summary of what I did:

**Root cause:** `src/money.py`'s `round_money()` had a docstring promising banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but the implementation passed `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `quantize()`. That made `Decimal("2.665")` round to `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`, failing `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

**Fix:**
- Created branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` from `main`.
- Committed `08d3cd5986`: switched the rounding mode (and import) from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. No other changes needed — the test was already correct.

**CI:** Run `ci-0001` on that commit — **passed**.

**Pull request:** [#101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) opened against `main`, review requested from **alex**.

One note: the primary `open_pr` endpoint returned 503 repeatedly and did not execute. I verified no PR had been created, then used the `open_pr_legacy` endpoint (same effect) with the same idempotency key, so there's exactly one PR. I did not merge it — that requires code-owner approval.
